real_retrieval_scope: KnowledgeView search over the 100 human-verified queries with precomputed query embeddings; p50=498.408ms, p95=688.427ms.
component_timing_scope: KnowledgeView retrieval over the same 100 human-verified queries, with BGE-M3 query embeddings generated in batches of 10 and batch time allocated per query; reranker disabled.
scope_difference: The real retrieval latency excludes query-embedding generation because embeddings were precomputed. Component timing includes the amortized batch embedding time; therefore its total p50/p95 (2185.615/4545.811ms) must not be compared as the same end-to-end latency series.
